999008199.text: あ、ミミちゃん見て！
なに？　ああ、生徒会選挙の立候補者リスト……

localizations.en: What is it? Oh, it's the list of student council election candidates...

999008199.text:
ええと……あ！　ユナ先輩の名前もちゃんとあるね！
ロロナ先輩の名前も一緒に書いてある

localizations.en: Let's see... Ah! June made it! And Rorona is listed as her endorser!

999008199.text:
生徒会長の候補は……全部で４名。
これが先輩のライバルってわけね

localizations.en: There are... four candidates for student council president in total. In other words, Juna's rivals.

999008199.text:
じゃあ、ポスターの構図はこんな感じで……
公約も載せるんだけど、それはお任せしていい？

localizations.en: So the poster layout should look something like this... We need to include your campaign promises too. Is it okay if I leave that part to you?

999008199.text: ああ、明日までにまとめておく

localizations.en: Yes, I'll have it prepared by tomorrow.

999008199.text: 先輩方！　見ましたよ、選挙の候補者リスト！

localizations.en: There you are! I saw the list of candidates for the election!

999008199.text: ああ。おかげさまで、無事に立候補が受理された

localizations.en: Yes. Thanks to Rorona, my candidacy was accepted without issue.

999008199.text: もしかして、選挙の打ち合わせをしてたんですか？

localizations.en: Were you two discussing the election?

999008199.text: うん！　選挙ポスターの内容を考えてたんだ

localizations.en: Yeah! We were working on the election poster.

999008199.text:
来週から、全候補者のポスターが
学園中に張り出される予定だ

localizations.en: All candidates' posters will be displayed throughout the academy next week.

999008199.text: おお！　それは楽しみです！

localizations.en: Oh! I can't wait to see them!

999008199.text: ――翌週
ミミちゃん！　見て、生徒会選挙のポスター！

localizations.en: Mimi! Look, the student council election posters!

999008199.text:
そんなに騒がなくても見えてるわよ。
ユナ先輩のは……あった、これね

localizations.en: You don't need to shout, I can see them just fine. Juna's is... ah, this one.

999008199.text:
なんという凛々しいお姿……！
シンプルながらスマートなデザイン！

localizations.en: What a dignified presence...! It's a simple yet sophisticated design!

999008199.text: なかなかいいセンスね
「全生徒の規範となるべく、邁進する」……うーん？

localizations.en: "I will strive to be a role model for all students"... Hmm?

999008199.text: どうしたの？

いや、ユナ先輩のポスターに書いてある公約。
なんかピンと来ないというか……

localizations.en: It's the campaign promise on Juna's poster. It just doesn't quite... resonate with me.

999008199.text:
普通、生徒会選挙って、「こういう学園にしたい」
っていうのをアピールするものじゃない？

localizations.en: Normally, student council candidates try to appeal to voters with a vision of what kind of academy they want to create, don't they?

999008199.text:
確かに……？　他の人たちのポスターは、
笑顔が絶えない学校、とかそういう風に書いてあるね

localizations.en: You're right... The other posters say things like "creating a school filled with smiles" and such.

999008199.text:
こっちは「全部活の予算アップ！」ですって。
俗っぽいけど、分かりやすいわね

localizations.en: This one says "Increased budget for all clubs!" It's kind of crude, but at least it's easy to understand.

999008199.text:
それに比べると、先輩のはどうもイメージが
湧きづらいというか……

localizations.en: Compared to those, it's hard to envision what Juna's actually planning to do for us...

999008199.text:
でも、ユナ先輩くらいの人なら、
ついていきたいって思う人は多いんじゃないかな

localizations.en: I think someone like Miss Juna would have lots of people who'd want to be like her!

999008199.text: ……ま、そうかもしれないわね

localizations.en: ...Well, you may be right about that.
